name: Host

facts.text: Level 79, 30,000 health each. Eight copies of Host appear; one is chosen as the real one, and killing it kills the rest.
Linked dead come with him: archliches, black revenants, cursed laculae, forerunners and heralds of trucidation (slaughter).

story: The keepers of Caer Sidi called him the Host because there was no other word for what he was: a multitude in one prisoner, a man who had died so many deaths in so many bodies that he came to Arawn's gaol as eight. Only one of the eight is him; the rest are the bodies he wore and could not quite take off. He keeps archliches and revenants around him like a household. Strike the true Host and the other seven drop where they stand, like coats falling off their pegs.
legend: Eight of him, one real. Kill the real Host and the rest die with him; kill a fake and you only lose time. Spread out, find the one that matters, and watch for the heralds and archliches that come with him.

aggro: We are many. We are one. Guess.

lairEntry: Eight of the same man. Seven of them are empty.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The true Host is dead. Seven bodies fall with him.
